name: banner-v2
prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a polished landscape 3:2 event banner for the fantasy casual browser game 'Ether Alchemy'. Reference image: use the golden gyroscope ether generator as the exact visual identity and main subject, not a screenshot. Composition: a magnificent luminous turquoise-blue rotating magical sphere held within warm gold rings, placed in the right half of an inviting alchemist laboratory. A floating open recipe book behind it and three charming round glass potion bottles (red, emerald green, honey gold) on the lower right foreground. Soft golden magical sparks connect the book, bottles and generator. Left 42 percent must stay visually quiet and light warm ivory/gold atmospheric wall, for HTML title overlay, no objects there. Bright elegant stylized game illustration, clean rounded volumetric forms, large glossy highlights, smooth colour transitions, readable silhouettes, restrained detail. Palette teal/cyan, natural warm gold, wood; avoid purple/amethyst dominance. No characters, no writing, no letters, no logo, no border, no watermark. Fully opaque background. Attractive composition at both 410x255 lobby tile and wide event card. Keep the full golden generator visible on the right, cinematic yet friendly.

name: generator-orb-v2
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game animation sprite. A single round cyan-blue magical energy sphere viewed straight on, perfectly circular, centred, with swirling curved ribbons and a strong spiral vortex inside it, matching the luminous blue ether orb of the reference golden generator. Sphere alone, remove ALL gold rings, supports, pedestal and scenery. Smooth volumetric casual fantasy game art, vivid deep azure edges with turquoise luminous spiral ribbons and ivory-cyan central core, large elegant readable swirls. Fully opaque rich blue interior of orb, transparent background OUTSIDE the circular sphere only. Circular orb fills 88% of the square canvas, equal padding, no ellipse, no outside sparkles, no shadow, no text, no gold. This sprite will be slowly rotated by code behind the original gold casing; swirls should clearly communicate rotation. Keep modest rim glow contained near circle.
